title: Smartagri Researchers Win Best Presenter Awards at the 2026 National Agrotropikal Seminar
author: Fahmi Arsyad
excerpt: Smartagri UGM researchers earned Best Presenter awards at the 2026 National Agrotropikal Seminar (Universitas Mulawarman, April 30), presenting five studies on precision irrigation, UAV-based stomatal conductance estimation, and ML-based crop health classification. The achievement reflects Smartagri's ongoing commitment to advancing smart agriculture research and scientific communication at the national level.
body:
_By: Fahmi Arsyad_

**Yogyakarta, April 30, 2026** — Researchers from the Smart Agriculture Research Center (Smartagri), Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering (DTPB), Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM), received Best Presenter awards at the 2026 National Agrotropikal Seminar, organized by the Faculty of Agriculture, Universitas Mulawarman, held online via Zoom Meeting on Thursday, April 30, 2026. The seminar was held under the theme _"Transformation of Agricultural Technology and Innovation for Food Security and Sustainable Agriculture"_ and was attended by academics, researchers, and students from various universities across Indonesia.

During the event, the Smartagri research team presented a range of studies focusing on the development of precision agriculture technologies and smart systems to support production efficiency and agricultural resource management. The presented research adopted data-driven approaches through the integration of digital technologies, control systems, and machine learning-based modeling to support decision-making in the modern agricultural sector. Through these presentations, the team also introduced technological developments aimed at building more efficient and sustainable farming systems.

The research titles presented at the seminar included:

- _Development of a Fuzzy Logic Algorithm for Sandy Soil Irrigation Optimization Based on Evapotranspiration and Soil Moisture_ — by Ardan Desta Vaunendra
- _Evaluation of Sprinkler Irrigation Implementation through Hydraulic Analysis and Water Distribution Uniformity Based on Christiansen Uniformity at Pantai Glagah Farmland, Kulon Progo_ — by Devi Ramdani
- _Quantification of External Factors as a Basis for Operator Performance Evaluation in the Sapon Irrigation Area_ — by Arinda Fadea Pramaesela
- _Estimation of Rice Stomatal Conductance Using an XGBoost Algorithm Based on UAV Multispectral Imagery_ — by Faiz Ridwan Pratama
- _Machine Learning-Based Classification of Papaya Plant Health from Leaf Physiological Data_ — by Muhammad Ilham Al Marda

Based on the quality of their presentations, Ardan Desta Vaunendra, Devi Ramdani, Arinda Fadea Pramaesela, and Ilham Al Marda received the **Best Presenter 1** award, while Faiz Ridwan Pratama received the **Best Presenter 2** award. The awards were given based on the quality of delivery, research substance, and the ability to address questions during the discussion session. This achievement serves as motivation for the research team to continue developing the quality of their research and scientific communication going forward.

The students involved in this research were supervised by Dr. Murtiningrum and Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho from the Smart Agriculture Research Center, Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada. The research activities were funded through the Priority Research Downstream Program – SINERGI, Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology 2025, as a form of support for the development of innovative research in smart farming and sustainable agriculture.

This participation and achievement demonstrate Smartagri's commitment to advancing research that is relevant to the needs of the modern agricultural sector. The seminar also served as a platform for expanding academic collaboration and the exchange of ideas among researchers in the fields of smart farming and sustainable agriculture, while supporting the strengthening of academic culture and scientific publication within higher education institutions.

![](/brand/uploads/12-5-7.webp) ![](/brand/uploads/12-5-8.webp)

The research activities and seminar participation were supported by the **Sinergi Program** and the **Working Group Food Security (WGFS 1.2) — Precision Agriculture and Smart Farming**, under the Center of Excellence Among Universities (**PUAPT**) Universitas Gadjah Mada, which provided research facility support. The activities also contribute to the achievement of **SDG 2** _(Zero Hunger)_, **SDG 9** _(Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure)_, and **SDG 13** _(Climate Action)_. The agricultural technology innovations developed are expected to support the efficiency and sustainability of agricultural production systems in the future.
